messages:
maya: quick follow-up from today's authz postmortem — consolidating owners, timelines, and next checks.

maya: Summary of root causes we saw: token TTL not enforced in gateway; missing request_id in audit logs for some services; manual service-account secret rotations led to gaps.

maya: Action items (owner — ETA):
- Token validation: enforce server-side TTL + add introspection endpoint; owner: dylan; ETA: 2026-04-07 (2w)
- Audit logging: ensure request_id + user_id fields mandatory, retro-fill missing entries for last 30d; owner: sasha; ETA: 2026-03-31 (1w)
- Secrets rotation: automate rotation for service accounts + add pre-rotate healthcheck; owner: tom; ETA: 2026-04-14 (3w)
- Permission drift detector: nightly reconcile + pagerduty on >5 unexpected grants; owner: olivia; ETA: 2026-03-31 (1w)

maya: I created a parent ticket INF-9123 and will link all PRs. Please add task tickets and update status weekly in that ticket.

dylan: ack — I'll start a branch for gateway enforcement. Quick question: do we want immediate reject for expired tokens or fall back to introspect and refresh?
dylan: prefer reject by default, fallback only for legacy clients. will add config flag.

sasha: starting infra ticket to patch logging schema. I'll also run a backfill job overnight to tag missing request_ids.

sasha: backfill query I'll use:
```
UPDATE audit_logs SET request_id = gen_random_uuid()
WHERE request_id IS NULL AND created_at >= now() - interval '30 days';
```

tom: I can wire the rotation playbook into Jenkins pipeline. need confirmation on KMS key rotation window.

olivia: adding PagerDuty escalation and a dashboard in console. Will surface a metric for 'unexpected-grant-count' and add alert.

sec-bot: Reminder: weekly follow-up check scheduled every Mon 09:00 UTC — INF-9123 status check.

maya: thanks all. next sync: Monday standup. Post updates as comments on INF-9123. Ping me if blockers.

olivia: noted. I'll add ownership tag and pair with oncall for first 2 weeks.

dylan: opened PR for gateway TTL enforcement: https://github.com/redwood/gateway/pull/456 — needs review from @sasha

sasha: reviewing now. small nit on logging middleware ordering.

maya: closing loop — please update last_message_ts when you post updates. :thumbsup:
